verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party AI agent, Rudder AI, for managing and interacting with the workspace, and its homepage describes AI-powered chat interfaces for analyzing, segmenting, and activating data. However, that agent runs in Slack rather than inside the product UI. The richer delegation capabilities (debugging delivery errors, writing and testing transformations) are offered through the MCP server to external clients, which is not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant embedded in the RudderStack UI, documentation of which tasks Rudder AI can carry out end-to-end, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the agent.
